name: pulmonology
description: Datenpaket für Pneumologen: SpO2 (24/7+Schlaf), Atemfrequenz, Husten/Atemnot
description_en: Data package for pulmonology: SpO2 (24/7+sleep), respiration rate, cough/dyspnea

queries.spo2_all: SELECT ts, date, value, unit, device_id, source_app FROM measurements WHERE metric IN ('spo2','oxygen_saturation') AND person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.respiration_rate: SELECT ts, date, value, source_app FROM measurements WHERE metric IN ('respiration_rate','respiration','respiratory_rate') AND person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.sleep_breathing: SELECT date, source_app, spo2_avg, respiration_avg, snore_s, body_temp_dev FROM sleep WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.breathing_symptoms: SELECT date, symptom, value_num, value_text FROM symptoms WHERE person = :person AND (symptom LIKE '%cough%' OR symptom LIKE '%Husten%' OR symptom LIKE '%shortness%' OR symptom LIKE '%Atemnot%' OR symptom LIKE '%wheez%' OR symptom LIKE '%breath%' OR symptom LIKE '%runny_nose%' OR symptom LIKE '%sinus%') AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.air_quality: SELECT date, aqi, pm25, pm10, temp_out_c, humidity_out_pct, pollen_grass, pollen_birch, pollen_mugwort, pollen_ragweed FROM daily_context WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to AND (aqi IS NOT NULL OR pm25 IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY date
